name: laya-router
description: Rates each prompt with a local laya-serve, names a model tier, fills it in on Agent calls and can route the main loop.

route.title: Route the main loop
route.description: Send an easy turn of an Opus session to Sonnet. Each switch writes the other model's prompt cache, so it can cost more than it saves.

routeMaxMessages.title: Route only up to this many messages
routeMaxMessages.description: Past this length the conversation stays on the session's model, because a switch would rewrite a large cache.
